newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India may raise rice output to 98 mln T - report.
newsitem.headline: India may raise rice output to 98 mln T - report.

text.p: India's rice production may rise to 98 million tonnes in five to seven years from the current 81 million tonnes, the chief executive of ITC Ltd's International Business Division said on Thursday.
"Scope exists for increasing India rice production to about 98 million tonnes in five to seven years," S. Sivakumar said in a report at the Asia rice conference in Singapore.
Output could be raised by maximising yields through better hybrid seeds or more intensive irrigation.

Rising population and income levels will also boost domestic demand by 3.0 percent annually and rice consumption in India may rise to around 90-95 million tonnes in five-seven years and up to 110 million tonnes in 10-12 years, Sivakumar said.
But if consumption grows 5.0 percent annually, demand may rise to 100 million tonnes in five-seven years and 130 million tonnes in 10-12 years, he added.
